messages:
maria: Hi team — heads up for Li's start. Offer asks 2026-04-20 but embassy moved the dependent H-4 appointment to 2026-05-10. Need to coordinate dependent EAD / benefits start and payroll. Li, can you summarize what docs you currently have?

li_chen: Hi — thanks. I have: USCIS receipt WAC-21-12345678, OPT EAD (exp 2026-05-01), passport, marriage certificate (scans ready). No stamped H-4 yet. Worried about health insurance gap if start is kept at 4/20.

jason_legal: We can provide two employer letters: (A) consulate support letter for the stamping/expedite request, and (B) benefits eligibility verification for the insurer to bridge coverage. I need scanned copies of the USCIS receipt + marriage cert + current EAD to sign.

maria: Thanks Jason. Also a payroll/legal note: we cannot put someone on payroll without work authorization. Options: delay official start until proof of H-4/EAD, onboard as contractor (if candidate agrees and contractor workflow cleared), or proceed with unpaid orientation. People Ops preference is delay + keep offer terms. @santosh what's the team's preference?

santosh: Team is flexible. We prefer Li to join as FTE on 4/20, but we can't violate authorization rules. If the candidate is OK with a short contractor arrangement for the gap, that would be ideal. Otherwise delaying start to 5/11 is acceptable.

li_chen: I'd rather delay to 5/11 to keep benefits intact and avoid contractor setup. I have some move/unaccommodation concerns but manager ok to push. If consulate gives earlier slot via expedite, can we revert to 4/20?

jason_legal: Yes — if documentation arrives that shows authorization before 4/20 we can backdate employment start pending background checks. For now I'll draft the letters. Posting drafts below — feel free to suggest edits.

jason_legal: ```
[Letter A] Consulate Support Letter
Redwood Inference
100 Redwood Way
Date: 2026-03-30
To: Consular Officer
Re: Support for H-4 Dependent Stamping — Li Chen (passport XXX)

This letter confirms that Li Chen has a valid offer of employment with Redwood Inference scheduled to begin 2026-04-20. Due to a delayed consular appointment for the dependent, we request consideration for an expedited appointment for the dependent spouse based on pending employment start and insurance coverage needs. Employer contact: maria@redwood.com, +1-555-0102.

Sincerely,
Jason Legal Counsel
```

jason_legal: ```
[Letter B] Benefits Eligibility Verification
To Whom It May Concern,
Redwood Inference confirms that Li Chen (SSN on file) is a new hire with benefits-eligible status contingent on proof of work authorization. If documentation demonstrating lawful work authorization is provided, policy start date will be aligned to candidate's official start date. In absence of proof before 2026-04-20, employer requests temporary coverage consideration.

Signed,
Jason Legal Counsel
```

maria: Great — Jason can you please send signed PDFs to li and upload to the secure HR folder. Li please upload scanned USCIS receipt, current EAD, passport, marriage cert to the secure folder (link below) so we can proceed with the insurer and expedite if needed.

hr-bot: Reminder: upload documents securely at https://redwood-secure/doc-upload — select folder: PEOPLE-OPS/IMMIGRATION/LI_CHEN

maria: Quick checklist and next steps:
1) Li uploads all requested docs (USCIS receipt, EAD, passport, marriage cert) — by EOD 2026-04-02
2) Jason to sign/send the two letters and cc: maria — by 2026-04-03
3) People Ops to confirm benefits cutover date with insurer and HRBP — target 2026-04-05
4) Manager (santosh) to confirm if team can support delayed start 2026-05-11 if stamping not complete — confirm by 2026-04-02

li_chen: Thanks all — uploading now. If anyone needs additional docs let me know. Appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:

maria: I'll follow up after docs and lock the official start date. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
